description: Read exact document content starting from any node. Pass a document root to read the whole document, or an exact passage/function/test node to inspect that unit. A root read without pagination is unbounded and intended only for small documents. For a bounded end-to-end reread, pass offset and limit, then continue with pagination.nextOffset until hasMore is false. Returns content, structure, and compact open attention. Add showRevisions: true for edit history and showProvenance: true for the recorded purpose, origin commit, and typed rationale relations that answer why this unit exists or changed.

limit.description: Maximum exact document units to return. Supplying offset or limit enables bounded pagination; default 10 in paginated mode.

nodeId.description: Node ID to start reading from. Can be a document root (whole doc) or any section (just that branch).

offset.description: Zero-based document-unit offset in depth-first reading order. Supplying offset or limit enables bounded pagination.

showProvenance.description: If true, include each unit's recorded purpose, origin commit, and all non-structural incoming/outgoing relations with their exact why. These are authored provenance claims, not verified causes.

showRevisions.description: If true, include full revision history for each section showing how it evolved. Default false.

name: doc_read
